title: Leome and Partners statement
description: A full-bleed photo panel, window-high on phones and 3:2 on wide screens, with two corner marks and a large medium-weight statement at the bottom-left over a dark scrim. The statement rises line by line as it scrolls in and the photo drifts against the scroll.
notes: made for light text over a dark photo: on light themes the scrim fades to the light card colour instead
all motion is CSS scroll-driven; off under prefers-reduced-motion
name: leome-and-partners-statement
